policy.meaning: Operational source coverage, not a claim of complete product or vulnerability coverage.

product_families: IOS/IOS XE, NX-OS and infrastructure products explicitly listed in advisories
cisco.history_scope: Current RSS window plus pinned historical advisories and upstream CVE references
known_gaps: Feed window is bounded; arbitrary historical advisories are not exhaustively enumerated.

product_families: ArubaOS and networking products encoded in the CSAF index
aruba.history_scope: Current CSAF index, benchmark search up to 200 documents; historical normalization resumes at 8 documents per scheduled pass
known_gaps: Index cap and exact inspected count are recorded; hardware/configuration qualifications remain source-defined.
Historical queue progress is reported separately; the listed index does not establish every product or earlier disclosure.

arista.history_scope: Current RSS plus curated historical HTML and structured advisories
known_gaps: Only reviewed layouts are supported; affected platforms and deployment scope require consulting the source.

product_families: GlobalProtect and other explicitly named product rows
paloalto.history_scope: Current RSS, CVE JSON and curated OSS bulletin tables
known_gaps: Shared multi-CVE tables remain shared unless a scoped exception is explicitly encoded.
Component presence alone does not establish exploitable exposure.

juniper.history_scope: Current security RSS metadata and two scoped PDF release documents
known_gaps: Application shells can prevent article extraction.
RSS discovery is not resolved product applicability; PDF adapters are deliberately narrow.

product_families: Products listed by the active advisory index
checkpoint.history_scope: Active product index plus two reviewed public SK articles
known_gaps: Active index is not a complete archive.
Details-in-SK rows remain unknown; IPS signatures do not establish affectedness.
Cloud requests to some support pages receive interactive bot-verification pages. These are classified as access gaps, never solved or treated as advisory content.

fortinet.history_scope: Current PSIRT RSS/CSAF plus curated product release-note pages
known_gaps: Some structured exports contain discovery metadata without product assessments.
Fixed release statements do not establish affected ranges in older firmware.

hpe.history_scope: Two pinned historical bulletins; no general HPE advisory discovery feed
known_gaps: This profile is a curated sample, not HPE-wide coverage.
Reported firmware dates are not independently verified public availability.
